summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that John Dwyer collected his $2,000 stake for beating Jim Elliott and said that, if Tom Allen were brought over, he would fight him for up to $5,000 a side.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Sunday Morning, May 18, 1879, page 4. New York dispatch dated May 17.

facts.fact: John Dwyer, the new American champion, said that if Allen were brought over he would, with his brother's consent, fight him for any sum up to $5,000 a side and give him his own field
